caption: Gérard Leman (1851–1920), commander of the fortified position of Liège — held the ring of forts from 4 August until he was pulled unconscious from the ruins of Fort Loncin on 15 August; the delay cost the German timetable its first days. Colorized (AI-assisted) from a public-domain photograph (1918, after his release from captivity).
